# openGym adaptation

The website directory is historical upstream material, not an adapted download channel.
Current architecture, supported features and build instructions: ../README.md and ../docs/README.md.
The adaptation uses local owner archives and optional official Firebase Auth/Firestore; own media stays local.
The old Node API, Coach, passkeys, server Web Push, vault, MCP and automatic upstream APK update are retired.
No public adapted demo, release or production migration is claimed.
